program.section_heading: Basic Barista Skill II - Certificate of Completion (CN)
outcomes: Demonstrate a working knowledge of a general overview of the specialty coffee supply chain and explore topics such as history and cultivation, variables that affect coffee quality, basics of sensory analysis, fundamentals of roasting, factors of coffee freshness, and principles of Brewing.

Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the essential practical skills of an espresso bar, required to process customer orders within limited-service times. While working as a barista in class, you will learn techniques such as effectively setting up the grinder, making espresso, frothing milk with proper texture and temperature for milk-based coffee drinks, and creating latte art.

Presentations – Demonstrate the ability to use critical thinking skills through various experience in difference customer experience various Demonstrate the proper presentation and service to the customers for different types of coffee: portion sizes, display, and garnishment.
Demonstrate the ability to apply communication skills in the workplace and to cooperate with the workflow with other team members during the shift and communicate effectively with team members.
